No new fd, HANDLE, socket, FILE*, sqlite or OpenSSL object, subprocess or production thread. Test resources: std::thread vectors in test_hardware_ci_read_cap_pg.cpp (both tests; JoinGuard releases the readers then joins on every path, explicit inline joins are also present), test_mcp_tools_hardware.cpp (shared-slot test guard and the burst() helper guard with try/catch in each thread body) and test_bulk_read_slots.cpp (the releaser thread is joined inline with no assertion between spawn and join); PG pool leases held by BlockedReaders across a condition_variable wait, released by release() or its destructor; the stored callback t.ci_read_hook captures parked/release by reference and is only invoked before the guard joins.
